verdict: During OSD (F8 command prompt), no mouse cursor appears after the reboot from WinPE. Windows Setup suppresses the cursor by design; MECM TS steps run within the Setup lifecycle so the suppression applies to them too.
fix: Cosmetic only; not a failure. If required for manual debugging, add a `Run Command Line` step that sets `reg add 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' /v EnableCursorSuppression /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f` before the `Setup Windows and ConfigMgr` step. Revert at the end of the TS if you do not want the change to persist in the deployed image.
